import urllib.request,json,collections
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments',timeout=6) as response:j=json.load(response)
items=j.get('assignments',[])
counts=collections.Counter();sus=[]
for x in items:
 st=x.get('state');attempt=x.get('dispatchSubmitAttempted') is True;cnt=int(x.get('dispatchCount') or 0)
 if attempt:counts[str(st)+'_send_attempted']+=1
 if cnt>0:counts[str(st)+'_dispatch_nonzero']+=1
 if st in ('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence') and (attempt or cnt):
  sus.append({'id':x.get('id'),'state':st,'attempted':attempt,'count':cnt})
 if st in ('blocked','failed') and attempt and not x.get('dispatchFingerprint'):
  sus.append({'id':x.get('id'),'state':st,'attempted':attempt,'reasonCategory':str(x.get('dispatchFailureCode',''))[:60]})
print(json.dumps({'total':len(items),'attempts':dict(counts),'potentialUnknown':sus[:16],'potentialUnknownCount':len(sus),'readOnly':True},ensure_ascii=True)[:4200])

note: Read-only assignment evidence state aggregation to determine if R41 can ever verify no outstanding unknown Sends; no text, no replays or mutation.
